body:
zsh completions generated by Starship is not directly source-able. You have multiple options:

- If you installed Starship (and perhaps zsh) from the same package manager, it should already be taken care of. This is the most case.
- Some zsh plugins/managers may also deal with the hassle.
- Generate and put the completion script into $fpath. [Instructions](https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-completions/blob/master/zsh-completions-howto.org#telling-zsh-which-function-to-use-for-completing-a-command).
- Or, let's make the script source-able

Take a look at the script:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/44045911/122673982-c5cabe00-d205-11eb-84f8-db6127decf62.png)

You will notice the last line calls `_starship`, which in turn calls the culprit `_arguments`. This is a helper function loaded by zsh's `compinit`, and as the message tells, can only be called from completion function.

To fix the script, simply remove the last line (via `sed '$d'`, `head -n -1` or whatever you prefer) and define the completion with `compdef _starship starship`:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/44045911/122673769-97001800-d204-11eb-9f14-ab68bea11929.png)

If you have any other questions, feel free to continue here.

Some tools are able to provide a directly sourceable completions, like kubectl command:
```
source <(kubectl completion zsh)
```
I think would be nice to have this as sourceable auto-completion. For my case, the oh-my-zsh doesn't have yet a plugin (kubectl it has one).

kubectl uses the Go CLI lib [Cobra](https://github.com/spf13/cobra) while Starship relies on Rust CLI lib [clap](https://github.com/clap-rs/clap). Looks like there already exists an issue: https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/issues/2479

> kubectl uses the Go CLI lib [Cobra](https://github.com/spf13/cobra) while Starship relies on Rust CLI lib [clap](https://github.com/clap-rs/clap). Looks like there already exists an issue: [clap-rs/clap#2479](https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/issues/2479)

Some useful/relevant snippets from that linked issue:

> Could you share how you're sourcing the completion script? I'm using clap v3 completions in [zoxide](https://github.com/ajeetdsouza/zoxide), and they're working fine on zsh. See my completions file [here](https://github.com/ajeetdsouza/zoxide/blob/b8bb6f0f85a5c778c3d9ba08b1434024f24df20f/contrib/completions/_zoxide).
> 
> AFAIK, a completion script is sourced by adding the containing folder to `$fpath`:
> 
> ```zsh
> fpath=("$HOME/ws/zoxide/contrib/completions" "${fpath[@]}")
> ```
> 
> _Originally posted by @ajeetdsouza in https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/issues/2479#issuecomment-845312113_
> 

> Have you called `compinit` after setting `fpath`?
> ```zsh
> autoload -Uz compinit && compinit
> ```
> I don't think you're supposed to `source` completions.
> 
> _Originally posted by @ajeetdsouza in https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/issues/2479#issuecomment-845882873_

---

While that linked issue for clap is now closed, it links to this issue about creating better documentation around how to properly source zsh completions:

- https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/issues/2488

Which seems to have some good information in it:

> I'd like to give a simple and general description:
> 
> - Bash: install [bash-completion](https://github.com/scop/bash-completion) (some distros have this by default), then the completions can be sourced
> - Zsh: the optimal way is to use `$fpath`, but if one would really like to go the manual way:
> 
>   ```sh
>   autoload -U compinit
>   compinit
>   source <(program completions zsh | sed '$d') # can also be `head -n -1` or whatever as long as the last line is removed
>   compdef _program program
>   ```
> 
>   FWIW, it is [said](https://github.com/starship/starship/issues/2806#issuecomment-864568502) that completions generated by [cobra](https://github.com/spf13/cobra) (clap counterpart in Go) can be directly sourced (i.e. no need to strip the last line), may worth looking into
> 
> - Fish: directly source-able 🎉
> 
> I don't have much experience with other shells so additions welcome.
> 
> _Originally posted by @kidonng in https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/issues/2488#issuecomment-864576617_

---

Since I installed `starship` with `brew`, it looks like the completions will be automatically generated anyway:

- https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/HEAD/Formula/starship.rb#L32
- https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/31ed6906f927ec7c63b72c6f5c7d72ea6baa2fb4/Library/Homebrew/formula.rb#L1686-L1754
